title: Bài thi thử nói lớp 12
topics: Life Stories We Admire · A Multicultural World · Green Living
note: Bài thi thử một lần, KHÁC dạng bài kiểm tra nghiên cứu: không tiếng bíp, không giới hạn thời gian, học sinh tự bấm khi sẵn sàng. Nhóm soạn theo Unit 1–3, chưa thầy cô duyệt. Không trùng đề A/B (test tự động kiểm tra).

questions.text: Who is a person you really admire?
Which foreign festival do you know about?
What do you do to live a greener life?
What foreign food have you tried?
What can young people learn from the life stories of famous people? Why?
Is it important to keep our cultural identity? Why?
Should people use public transport more often? Why?
Would you like to study abroad? Why or why not?
A foreign friend wants to experience Vietnamese culture. What would you suggest?
Your school wants to reduce plastic waste. Suggest two ideas and explain them.
